Definition: from G2596; and G3739 and G5100; according to which certain thing, i.e. as far (or inasmuch) as:--(according, forasmuch) as, because (that).
BiblicalUsage: Kathoti means inasmuch as, because, the word that gives the reason. Luke 19:9 has Jesus saying salvation is come to this house, forsomuch as Zacchaeus also is a son of Abraham, and Acts 2:24 says God raised Jesus up because it was not possible that death should hold him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the reason always runs back to God: salvation came because Zacchaeus belonged, and death lost because it could not hold Christ.
